ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate >90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized spots and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white circular blobs concentrated on the distal tips and scattered across the central surfaces; linear white streaks concentrated in the mid-to-lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior pixel angle approximately 65-75 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; high-amplitude jagged protrusions localized at the left and right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted by high-frequency jagged variations in pixel boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (3-15 pixels in diameter) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) present, with a higher density on the right fluke lobe and central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified protrusions (likely barnacles) clustered on the outer edge of the left distal tip; significant tissue loss/irregularity on the right distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of high-intensity white textural anomalies concentrated specifically on the posterior trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
